scope: all modified or new non-Markdown runtime, renderer, runner, shim, manifest, and test inputs relative to source_base_sha; task evidence directories and legacy debug logs excluded
intent_scope: all modified or new release files, including documentation and the two exact-image evidence directories; this release-tree evidence directory is excluded to avoid a self-hash cycle
verification: sha256sum -c RUNTIME_SHA256SUMS and sha256sum -c INTENT_SHA256SUMS from the worktree root
